description: Frozen author-labeled source-support evaluation against the bundled Handbook v2.0. These cases were not used to implement router rules, but are not independently reviewed or statistically representative.

cases.query: What are Sankalpa's standard working hours?
supporting_passages: Sankalpa standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Monday through Friday.

cases.query: How many remote days may eligible teams normally approve?
supporting_passages: Eligible teams may normally approve up to 2 remote days per

cases.query: How many annual leave days are available each calendar year?
supporting_passages: Annual leave 12 days per calendar year.

cases.query: How much unused annual leave can carry forward?
supporting_passages: up to 5 unused annual-leave days may carry forward

cases.query: When is the monthly pay cycle in this simulation?
supporting_passages: Monthly, on the last working day of the month for this simulation.

cases.query: What is the maximum yearly wellness allowance?
supporting_passages: eligible employees may claim up to INR 12,000 per calendar year

cases.query: How often does Sankalpa conduct formal performance reviews?
supporting_passages: Sankalpa conducts performance reviews twice each year.

cases.query: Who should employees contact about potential fraud?
supporting_passages: Potential fraud, bribery, harassment or retaliation: contact People Operations or the ethics channel promptly.

cases.query: What should an employee do after suspected phishing?
supporting_passages: Employees must report suspected phishing or data loss to IT immediately.

cases.query: What is the deadline to submit a travel expense?
supporting_passages: Submit the expense in the portal within 30 days of the transaction or trip completion.

cases.query: When is written Ethics approval needed for a vendor gift?
supporting_passages: gifts with a value above INR 5,000 from a current or prospective vendor, customer or partner require written Ethics approval before acceptance.

cases.query: How much written notice is expected when an employee resigns?
supporting_passages: Employees who resign from Sankalpa are expected to provide 30 days of written notice.
